summary: Implementation plan for fixing the cut-off friend profile bottom sheet on 3-button navigation devices, allowing challenge re-launches after surrendering/abandoning, removing challenge progress cards from the Focus screen so the Pomodoro circle stays full size, and upgrading Friend Challenges into a multi-friend Study Group with live focus progress, group chat (custom messages + quick emojis), and sound + vibration focus nudges when a friend is paused or idle.
